properties.description:
The remaining two parts of req:a-report-says-what-it-swept-and-whether-its-checks-ran, plus one instance the work itself created. (The guard matched that Requirement, which this SATISFIES rather than restates: the requirement says what must be true, this is the built thing that makes it true.)

(b) `disconnected_community` SAID "disconnected from the rest of the design" AND WALKED SOMETHING NARROWER. dev_storyflow's report is exact and both halves are true at once: the nodes it named WERE reachable by an undirected walk of the graph. `design_network()` is not the graph — it drops nine node types and every review record, and CONTAINS is not a traceability edge, so a node reachable only through AUTHORED_BY, or only downward through containment, is an island there and connected here. MEASURED 2026-08-17: the walk covers 1133 of 2413 nodes. More than half the graph sits outside the thing whose absence the message called "the rest of the design". The message now states what it computed (no traceability edge to the main body), how much of the graph the walk held, which exclusions most often explain a false island, and how many singletons the rule does not report. THE CATEGORY KEY IS DELIBERATELY NOT RENAMED: consumers match on `disconnected_community` and it is an ility source, so renaming it to be accurate would break them to fix a sentence. The other half of their report — "the genuinely unreachable node was never mentioned" — is answered by the degree-zero rule of the previous epoch, since a node with no edges is unreachable in the full graph and is now reported whatever its type.

(c) `open_questions` RETURNING 0 READ AS AN ALL-CLEAR while `loop_status` in the very next call reported 31 other owed items — and it is the orientation call a session runs FIRST. It now carries a `loop_hint` on an empty answer, un-throttled. THE THROTTLE IS THE INTERESTING PART: `dec:read-hint-shape` option C surfaces a hint once and then stays quiet so reads do not nag, which is right while the reader is being handed findings and INVERTS when the answer is empty — the throttle then removes the only sentence in the reply and leaves a zero to speak for itself. So empty answers are exempt and non-empty ones are not, and an empty answer always says which zero it is: the other non-zero debt named, or an explicit all-clear. "Nothing to show you" and "nothing is owed" stop sharing a reply.

⚠️ AND THE CHANGE CREATED A THIRD INSTANCE, CAUGHT BY DRIVING THE BUILT BINARY RATHER THAN BY A TEST. The scoped detectors attach a note saying "`in_scope: 0` is VACUOUS rather than clean — nothing could have been found here", gated only on the region being one node. That was true while every structural rule needed an edge to fire. The degree-zero rule ended it: a node attached to nothing IS the finding and lives in exactly that one-node region. The first scoped call against the new binary returned `in_scope: 1`, a real finding, and that note beside it. The gate is now region-of-one AND found-nothing. Nothing was comparing the prose to the number it described.
properties.name: A finding describes the walk that produced it, and an empty orientation read says which zero it is
